system.name: Oobleck
system.one_liner: a system for resilient distributed training of large models using heterogeneous pipeline templates

components.name: Pipeline Template Generator
components.role: generates a set of heterogeneous pipeline templates once, before training begins

components.name: Distributed Execution Engine
components.role: enables efficient heterogeneous pipeline execution by instantiating and running pipelines from the templates

components.name: Pipeline Instantiator
components.role: instantiates at least f+1 pipeline replicas from the given templates considering the fault-tolerance threshold

components.name: Batch Distributor
components.role: calculates the number of microbatches per pipeline to balance execution latency across heterogeneous pipelines

components.name: Node Change Monitor
components.role: detects node failures and additions and triggers pipeline reconfiguration

components.name: Node Cluster
components.role: pool of homogeneous nodes each running an agent, GPUs, and pipeline execution

components.name: Agent
components.role: per-node agent; one is highlighted (red dashed) as the node currently affected by a failure/change

components.name: Pipeline Execution
components.role: runs the assigned pipeline stage on a node's GPUs

components.name: GPUs
components.role: hardware resources on each node used for pipeline execution

flows.what: Job Submission (fault tolerance threshold f, model, dataset, batch info)

content.key_idea: Oobleck separates a one-time pipeline template generator from a distributed execution engine that instantiates and dynamically reconfigures heterogeneous pipeline replicas across a node cluster as nodes fail or are added.
content.reading_order: Bottom-left person icon (Job Submission, step 1) into the Oobleck box, left-to-right through Pipeline Template Generator to Distributed Execution Engine (steps 2-3) down into the Node Cluster, then back up through Node Change Monitor to the engine (steps 4-5).

palette.used_for: highlighted failing/changed Agent and GPUs (red dashed box) and the failure-related arrow/label (New Node Addition & Failure Detection)
background panels for the Oobleck box and Node Cluster box (light gray)

style.font: HelveticaNeue sans, 6-8pt, bold for component titles
style.arrows: orthogonal arrows with filled triangular heads, small vector glyph depicting a pipeline graph inside the template generator icon
style.icons: vector: small pipeline-graph icon in Pipeline Template Generator, person icon for job submission

encoding.color_means: red = the specific agent/node currently affected by a failure or reconfiguration; gray = static grouping backgrounds (Oobleck service, Node Cluster); black = normal/healthy components
encoding.line_style_means: dashed red box calls out the specific failing/changing node; solid black arrows with circled step numbers trace the end-to-end job/recovery flow
encoding.emphasis: circled step numbers 1-5 walk the reader through the job-submission-to-recovery flow, and a single red-dashed Agent+GPUs box highlights the fault-handling path among otherwise identical repeated nodes
reusable_patterns: numbered end-to-end flow overlaid on a control-plane/data-plane box layout
one element recolored/dashed among repeated identical elements to indicate the faulty instance

evidence: it has a pipeline template generator to generate a set of heterogeneous pipeline templates
Oobleck has a distributed execution engine that enables efficient heterogeneous pipeline execution
The node change monitor detects node failure(s) and node additions

summary: This figure gives Oobleck's system overview as a numbered end-to-end flow. A user submits a training job (step 1: fault-tolerance threshold f, model, dataset, batch info) into the Oobleck control plane, shown as a gray box containing a Pipeline Template Generator that produces a set of heterogeneous pipeline templates (step 2) and a Distributed Execution Engine, itself containing a Pipeline Instantiator and Batch Distributor, which instantiates pipelines onto a Node Cluster (step 3). Below, the Node Cluster is drawn as repeated groups of Agent, Pipeline Execution, and GPUs boxes; one Agent+GPUs pair is highlighted with a red dashed border to represent a node change. A Node Change Monitor detects such failures or additions (step 4) and feeds back into the Distributed Execution Engine to trigger dynamic reconfiguration (step 5), closing the loop between the control plane and the executing node cluster.
summary_zh: 图3展示Oobleck系统总览：用户提交训练任务(步骤1)进入灰色的Oobleck控制面，流水线模板生成器生成异构流水线模板(步骤2)，分布式执行引擎(含流水线实例化器与批次分配器)据此在节点集群上实例化流水线(步骤3)；节点集群中一个Agent+GPU用红色虚线突出表示故障/变更节点，节点变更监视器检测到后(步骤4)反馈执行引擎进行动态重配置(步骤5)。
